new Promise(res=>{const C=window.__C, cols=window.__cols; const ids=['w4','w5','omar','reception']; const hits={}; let n=0; const iv=setInterval(()=>{ for(const id of ids){ const c=C[id]; if(!c||!c.holder.visible) continue; const p=c.holder.position; for(const k of cols){ if(p.x>k.x0+0.05&&p.x<k.x1-0.05&&p.z>k.z0+0.05&&p.z<k.z1-0.05){ hits[id]=(hits[id]||0)+1; break; } } } if(++n>=200){clearInterval(iv); res(JSON.stringify({samples:n, insideObstacle:hits, w5:[C.w5.holder.position.x.toFixed(1),C.w5.holder.position.z.toFixed(1)]}));} },200);})
